items: 1 cup walnuts or pecans, chopped to medium pieces
2 cups or 350 grams Pamela’s Baking & Pancake Mix

steps.title: Preheat and grease the pan
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease 10-cup Bundt or 9-inch springform pan.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: Mix together filling ingredients in a small bowl: **1 cup walnuts or pecans**, chopped to medium pieces, **¼ cup granulated sugar**, **¼ cup light brown sugar** and **2 teaspoons ground cinnamon**; set aside.

steps.title: Soften the butter
steps.body: To make cake batter, soften **⅔ cup butter** in the bowl of an electric stand mixer with paddle attachment. Add **1 cup granulated sugar** and mix well.

steps.title: Add the eggs and vanilla
steps.body: Add **2 eggs**, large, one at a time, then **1 teaspoon vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the mix and sour cream
steps.body: On low speed, alternately add **2 cups or 350 grams Pamela’s Baking & Pancake Mix** and then **1 cup sour cream** until incorporated.

steps.title: Layer the batter
steps.body: Spoon half of the batter into the pan, covering the bottom. Sprinkle half of the filling over the batter evenly, repeat with a layer of batter, then sprinkle the remaining filling evenly over the batter.

steps.title: Marbleize
steps.body: Take a knife and insert straight down into batter moving up and down around the pan in a zigzag motion to marbleize cake. Do not smooth out the batter.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Remove from the pan
steps.body: While warm, run a knife around the edges. When cool, remove from the pan.
